# Third-party libraries

| File | Library | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pptxgen.bundle.js` | [PptxGenJS](https://github.com/gitbrent/PptxGenJS) (bundles [JSZip](https://github.com/Stuk/jszip)) | 3.12.0 (JSZip 3.10) | MIT (JSZip: MIT or GPLv3, used under MIT) |

Used in the browser to build the Google Slides (.pptx) and Google Sheets (.xlsx) exports. Nothing is sent to a server unless the user chooses *Create in my Google Drive*.
| `docx.min.js` | [docx](https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx) (minified with terser) | 8.5.0 | MIT |

`docx.min.js` builds the Word version of the proposal and is loaded only when someone downloads it.
